messages:
kevin: FYI Zephyr POC is blocked: their Vector forwarder shows exported events in Log Analytics but traceparent/trace_id fields are missing and they're getting intermittent 429 + occasional 502 from our drain. Can eng take a look?
nina: On it. Do we have a sample raw event and the forwarder config they use? Also which drain endpoint (stream vs batch)?
kevin: They're using the standard /v1/logs/drain with batch mode enabled in Vector. Sample event they see in LA: `{"time":"2026-03-19T23:04:12Z","app":"zephyr","trace":"","request_id":"r_7c9b"}`.
jorge: Two quick hypotheses: 1) Vector is aggregating and replacing headers during batching (loses `traceparent`). 2) Our route-level rate limiter is tripping because Vector bursts multiple events per HTTP request causing a larger payload.
tara: Customer says Vector config includes `batch.timeout_secs = 1` and `batch.max_bytes = 5_000_000`. They also mentioned they can't change much on their side today.
nina: Can we run two checks: a) temporarily raise the drain burst quota for zephyr-poc; b) ask the customer to send a single-event curl with `traceparent` header to confirm end-to-end propagation. Example: `curl -v -H "traceparent: 00-4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736-00f067aa0ba902b7-01" -d '{"msg":"ping"}' https://api.redwood.ai/v1/logs/drain` and confirm LA entry.
jorge: Also ask them to change Vector to include `request.headers.traceparent` in the body template or set `batch.keep_headers = true` on the runtime if they're hitting an older runtime. We had a runtime change last year where batching dropped request headers unless explicitly enabled.
kevin: Opened internal ticket POCP-7891 to bump quota and track this. Will update customer.
observability-bot: quota adjust applied for account zephyr-poc; change_id q_3321; new drain burst = 3x for 6h.
tara: I told customer about the curl test and the workarounds. They ran the curl with the traceparent header and Log Analytics shows `trace` present for that single event. So propagation path is fine.
nina: That confirms our drain preserves headers when single-request. So problem is batching path. Can we snapshot the raw HTTP body we got from Vector when multiple events are batched?
kevin: Customer pasted one raw multi-event body in the thread DM, forwarded to you, Nina.
nina: Looking at raw: Vector concatenates newline-delimited JSON but doesn't inject per-event headers. The forwarder expects headers to be per-request not per-event. So when Vector batches, the single request header only maps to the first event in some drain templates. Fix: modify the drain template to prefer `{{request.headers.traceparent}}` or change Vector to unbatch.
jorge: Short-term fixes: 1) keep the quota bump for 6h while they run tests; 2) we can push a conservative change to the customer's runtime: `redwood.runtime.batch.keep_headers = true` to ensure headers are copied into each sub-event during internal batching. This is a runtime toggle; impact minimal.
tara: Customer asked about cost if we keep quota bump for longer. Any rough numbers?
jorge: For rough order-of-magnitude: doubling burst for 6h at their traffic adds ~0.2GB egress and negligible compute. I'll DM precise estimate.
nina: I can roll the runtime toggle for their instance now. Will do a rolling restart of the forwarder. Deploy bot will post status.
nina: Also set Console -> Observability -> Traces sampling override = 100% for this POC window so we can correlate traces to logs. Remember to revert after.
nina: Pushing config change: `apply config ch_rc_554`. Restarting forwarder.
observability-bot: config apply started for zephyr-poc; change id ch_rc_554; rolling restart initiated.
observability-bot: rolling restart complete for zephyr-poc; all healthy.
tara: Customer re-ran their Vector tests. LA now shows trace populated for most events. A handful still empty (older events or ones that were already queued).
kevin: Good. Follow-ups: (1) Confirm customer updates Vector template to include `request.headers.traceparent` mapping or set `transform` to inject `trace` into the body. (2) Keep sampling override and quota bump for 6h then revert. (3) Add a short note in the POC handover doc about Vector-specific guidance.
jorge: I'll draft the Vector note and a sample template snippet: ```
# In Vector sink transform
[sink_transform] 
type = "remap"
inputs = ["sink"]
source = ''' .trace = parse_syslog!(.message) ?? "" .trace = to_string!(request.headers.traceparent) '''
```
nina: Marking POCP-7891 as in-progress. I'll monitor logs for 6h and if 429/502 recur we'll re-open.
tara: I'll update the customer and ask them to confirm after 6h. Thanks team :tada:
